videos.desc: Two hikers with helmets and headlamps squeeze through a rocky entrance overgrown with ivy and walk into a dark cave, their lights revealing an underground lake and huge stalactites; one calls 'Hello?' into the echo.

A couple in rain jackets walks up to the grassy edge of a massive dark sea cliff. They carefully lie down on their stomachs and peek over the edge at the waves crashing far below, laughing in amazement.

By an open window above a coastal village, a young couple lean over a desk globe, spin it and stop it with a hand. They point at a spot on the little blue planet and grin at each other saying this is where they are, while a cat sleeps on the windowsill.

A golden wheat field stretches to the horizon at sunset as a couple walks down a narrow path through it. They brush their hands over the ripe wheat, hold up a single stalk against the sun, and the woman runs laughing along the path between the tall rows.

A red-haired woman and a young man walk from a green meadow in among huge tall trees. Deep inside the woods they tilt their heads back to stare up at the towering trunks as sunbeams cut through the mist, spread their arms wide and say 'Oh wow, so nice.'

A couple climbs over a wooden fence and walks through a green alpine meadow toward a clear stony stream. They quietly watch two deer grazing on the far bank, then lie down side by side in the wildflower grass gazing up at the sky.
From the deck of a sailboat, endless deep-blue water stretches to the horizon under a clear sky. Dolphins leap out of the waves beside the boat while the crew in sailing jackets points and cheers.

Two people race autumn leaves on a crystal-clear turquoise river running over pebbles between forested banks; the leaves drift with the current past a grey heron that finally flies off low over the water.

A couple in a misty green valley push with all their strength against a giant round rock that will not move, slide off it into the grass, then climb up the boulder instead and stand on top cheering with raised arms.

On a beach at sunset a young man lets dry sand pour from his fist into his other palm and shows a handful mixed with tiny pebbles; bare feet press footprints into the wet sand, a woman draws a big spiral in it with a stick, and a wave washes over the drawing.

On a frosty field at low sun, a woman points up at a long V of geese migrating across the sky; a group of villagers climbs over a stone wall, plants a wooden direction post, and walks off across the stubble field following the birds toward the horizon.
A couple kneels beside a clear, narrow stream winding through a green sheep pasture, dips their hands in the cold flowing water, floats a small leaf boat on it, and finally jumps across it laughing.

On a windy hill summit, a woman in a purple jacket stacks flat stones onto a tall rock cairn, reaching higher and higher until she balances the last stone on the very top, then steps back and spreads her arms in triumph.

Two friends walk across a golden meadow at sunset toward a huge old oak tree. They press their hands against its rough bark, say how big it is, and crane their necks up at the massive trunk and spreading branches above them.
A hiking couple reaches a grassy ridge and stops in awe above a huge green valley where a silver river winds between steep cliffs. They spread their arms, point at the view and dance around happily.

A couple stands in silhouette on a grassy ridge above a sea of clouds at dawn, watching a huge cone-shaped volcano. A thick column of smoke rises from its crater, and as night falls the top glows orange with lava; music only.

A hiker crouches at a rocky forest stream and fills a glass bottle straight from the current. She holds the bottle up against the sun to show how clear it is, drinks deeply and smiles at her hiking partner before they walk on.
Two swimmers turn to see a huge green wave rising behind them at the beach. It curls and crashes right over their heads, and they come up in the foam and sprint out of the surf onto the sand.

A first-person view looking down the body of a climber in a red jacket standing on a glacier. Both gloved hands hold ice axes and the boots below wear steel crampons biting into the surface. The climber swings an axe into a bulging wall of blue-white ice and works up it.

A woman with a blonde ponytail climbs an overhanging white limestone cliff, filmed from above so the forest sits far below her. Her chalked fingers pull on small pockets in the stone while her feet smear against the wall. A rope runs from her harness down through quickdraws clipped to the face.

A flock of sheep grazes on the steep grassy sides of a narrow stream running through a misty green valley. One by one the sheep gather at the edge, then leap the water and land on the grass opposite. A shepherd and a black-and-white dog stand among the flock on the far side.
